- [[Assembly Machine|Assembly Machine]] : 8 x Titanium Plate, 4 x ingot (high explosive), [[gv:circuit_basic|Integrated Circuit Board]] - [[gv:schemas|blueprint required]]: Conventional warheads.

Used to make :
